messages:
marta: Kickoff for AuroraHealth POC perf validation. They need microburst recovery proof + per-10k-token cost for the bursty UI mix. Can we get a short run matrix and sec checklist by EOD?

leo: Proposed matrix: 1) Ramp+soak: ramp to 2.5k qps over 5m, hold 45m. 2) Burst phase: 12k qps for 12s x5 with 40s spacing. 3) Failover: during a burst route 30% to a smaller model to show graceful degradation. Capture p50/p95/p99 token latency, enqueue_wait_ms, avg_batch_size, and error-rate.

ash: Ops notes: warm caches 15m before spike, enable continuous batching, max_batch_ms=15. For Dedicated runs pin shards and enable key-caching if BYOK. We'll tag tests `aurora-poc`.

marta: Minimal smoke commands (adapt to k6/wrk):
```
python tools/loadgen.py --mix "short:70,long:30" --prompt-len 35 --resp-len 50 --qps 2500 --duration 45m --tag aurora-poc
python tools/loadgen.py --burst-qps 12000 --burst-duration 12 --bursts 5 --warmup 15m --out results/burst.json
```

leo: Cost sketch request: hosted vs dedicated per-10k tokens for this mix. Ballpark: hosted ~$0.026 / 10k tokens under burst; dedicated reserved ~$0.014 / 10k tokens if baseline retained. We'll produce a detailed calc after exact prompt distribution.

sec-bot: Sec questionnaire link uploaded: https://redwood-internal/sq/1200 POC requires IP allowlist + audit log extracts. BYOK allowed for POC; HSM optional.

marta: Customer asks whether KMS adds tail latency. Ops: KMS calls ~6-11ms; enable on-host derived-key caching (TTL 30s) for POC to avoid per-request KMS. Document tradeoffs in answers.

ash: Ops will reserve a Dedicated slot for the POC window to reduce noise. ops-bot:reservation_id=dh-res-79012

ops-bot: Reservation dh-res-79012 created for 2027-03-08T14:00Z, pool=dedicated-standard-6.

marta: Next steps: Leo to post runbook + cost calc by Tue noon. Ash to finalize warmup/key-cache config. Sec-bot to confirm items 1.1-1.4. Smoke run scheduled Wed 14:30 UTC. Tag blockers here. :white_check_mark:
